scope: Kaufmann folios101v–108v: Nedarim and Gittin opening, both main columns, including physically present Ketubbot boundary.
method: All15original manuscript pages visually inspected; all30main columns independently transcribed as uncertain consonantal attempts before source-position lookup. Only exact matching sequences were subsequently source-bound. Seven positive individual vowel signs are separately recorded from lossless crop enlargement; no complete vowel inventory or Accordance comparison is certified.
